mapper.insert: insert into ssm_migrate_bizsplit_mapping ( object_type, old_id, old_name, new_id, new_name, old_biz_line, new_biz_line, portal_id, is_reused, created_by, created_time ) values ( #{objectType}, #{oldId}, #{oldName}, #{newId}, #{newName}, #{oldBizLine}, #{newBizLine}, #{portalId}, #{isReused}, #{createdBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select menu_id as menuId, portal_id as portalId, menu_name as menuName, menu_type as menuType, parent_menu_id as parentMenuId, menu_desc as menuDesc, content_ref_id as contentRefId, sort_id as sortId from ssm_portal_menu where is_active = 1 and parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId} and menu_type = #{menuType} and menu_name = #{menuName} limit 1

select ctg_id as id, ctg_name as name, ctg_type as type, ctg_desc as description, sort_id as sortId, ctg_parent_id as parentId, created_by as createdBy from ssd_query_template_ctg where is_active = 1 and ctg_parent_id = #{parentId} and ctg_name = #{name} limit 1

select portal_id as portalId, portal_name as portalName, portal_desc as portalDesc, sort_id as sortId, is_active as isActive from ssm_portal where is_active = 1 and portal_name = #{portalName} limit 1

select tpl_id as tplId, tpl_name as tplName, tpl_desc as tplDesc, tpl_type as tplType, cfg_id as cfgId, tpl_owner as tplOwner, ctg_id as ctgId, dataset_id as datasetId from ssd_query_template where ctg_id = #{ctgId} and tpl_name = #{tplName} limit 1

select analysis_tpl_id as analysisTplId, analysis_tpl_name as analysisTplName, analysis_tpl_owner as analysisTplOwner, analysis_tpl_desc as analysisTplDesc, draft_status as draftStatus, online_status as onlineStatus, is_active as isActive, source_data_type as sourceDataType, has_ai_summary as hasAiSummary, analysis_tpl_type as analysisTplType from ssm_analysis_tpl_base where analysis_tpl_id = #{analysisTplId} and is_active = 1 limit 1
